title: fix(service-automation): an install-local package keeps its flows registered after a restart, whatever the plugin order
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DPZVafoyPJiw5GSH3KRXGJh)_

Fixes #33049

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
1. 问题:通过 install-local 安装的包,重启后对象还在,但它的流程没注册到自动化引擎,触发返回 404,要等下一次随便装个包才恢复。
2. 原因:引擎只在自己的 `kernel:ready` 里做一次开机流程绑定;install-local 在它自己的 `kernel:ready` 里才恢复已装包。谁先跑取决于插件启动顺序。
3. 为什么只有 showcase 中招:连接器插件都声明依赖自动化插件,showcase 又把 install-local 排在连接器之后,于是自动化插件先启动、先绑定,恢复的包就漏了。空白应用和 app-todo 的 install-local 由 CLI 先挂载,所以不受影响。
4. 修复:引擎在 `kernel:bootstrapped`(所有 `kernel:ready` 跑完之后、封存流程归属之前)再读一次流程视图,视图有变化才补绑一次;没变化什么都不做。与 #28591 对连接器的做法一致。
5. 不是 18.3.0 回归:18.3.0 版本提交上四个条件全都已经存在(卡片评论 6850890576),因此按冻结规则本 PR 不进合并队列,除非 triage 改判为阻塞。
6. 验证:真实 `objectstack dev` 在文件库上重启 showcase,修复前触发 404、修复后 200 且 `registered`;新增 dogfood 重启 pin 和单元 pin,把修复拿掉两者都变红。

## What changes

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts`: a `kernel:bootstrapped` pass (`bindFlowsRegisteredDuringBoot`) on the flow sync queue. The `kernel:ready` bind (`syncFlowsFromProtocol`) now records a fingerprint of the flow view it read (`flowViewFingerprint`: every flow's whole definition, order-free). At `kernel:bootstrapped`, which fires once every `kernel:ready` handler has settled whatever the plugin order, the view is read again; when it differs, the same additive bind runs over it (logged `Bound N flow(s) from the protocol at kernel:bootstrapped`). An unchanged view binds nothing; a boot whose `kernel:ready` bind read no view does nothing. The hook is registered before the plugin's own seal/audit `kernel:bootstrapped` hook, so the rebound flows are in place before `sealFlowHolders`, the node-type audit and the trigger-binding audit. The #28591 comment that claimed "Its flows already bind" is corrected.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/service-automation` patch.

Why there and not in the install-local rehydrate: the defect is the engine's assumption that every package registered in a `kernel:ready` handler is registered before its own; any plugin registering flows there meets it. Announcing `metadata:reloaded` from the rehydrate would run every reload consumer during the boot, which the install-local plugin explicitly does not do at `kernel:ready`.

## Mechanism (measured on main c4196099)

- Real restart: scratch copy of `examples/app-showcase`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch` over a file DB with an isolated `OS_HOME`, the card's manifest. Before the fix: install 200, trigger 200, restart, trigger **404** `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, `registration.state: unregistered`, banner `33 flow(s)`. With the fix: trigger 200, `registered`, banner `34 flow(s)`.
- Debug log of the failing boot: plugin start order `service-automation` #17, the four connector plugins #18 to #21, `marketplace-install-local` #23; `[Automation] Bound 33 flow(s) from the protocol at kernel:ready` at 10:55:17.997Z, `[MarketplaceInstallLocal] rehydrated com.qa.solo@1.0.0` at 10:55:18.372Z.
- The kernel's dependency sort starts a plugin's declared dependencies first; all four connector plugins declare `dependencies = ['com.objectstack.service-automation']`.

## Tests

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/install-local-restart-connectors.dogfood.test.ts`: a second top-level `describe` in the shared harness file. It mounts `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` inside the showcase's own `plugins`, after the plugins that depend on the automation plugin, where the showcase lists it. The existing describe passes it through `extraPlugins`, which `bootStack` mounts before the app's plugins, so it never met the CLI's order. Pins: the composition precondition, the pre-restart install and trigger, the listing after the restart, the trigger by name after the restart (200), and `registration.state: registered` after the restart.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-cold-boot-bind.test.ts`: a new top-level `describe` on a `LiteKernel`: a plugin registered after the automation plugin adds a packaged flow to the protocol's view in its own `kernel:ready` handler; after `bootstrap()` the flow is registered, beside the one the `kernel:ready` bind registered.

Ablation (both negative pins, fix reverted to origin/main in the tree and `service-automation` rebuilt, then restored from HEAD):
- dogfood: `Tests  2 failed | 8 passed (10)`; `after the restart, the package's flow triggers by name`: `expected 404 to be 200` (`RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`); `after the restart, the package's flow reads registered`: `expected 'unregistered' to be 'registered'`. Restored: `Tests  10 passed (10)`.
- unit: `Tests  1 failed | 5 passed (6)`, `registered after a later kernel:ready handler added it: expected null not to be null`. Restored: `Tests  6 passed (6)`.

## Acceptance notes

- Release check: not a regression vs 18.3.0 (card comment 6850890576). 18.4.0 merge freeze: this PR stays out of the merge queue unless triage grades the card a blocker.
- Reach beyond the showcase: any host that wires its own `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` after a plugin that depends on the automation plugin met the same loss. A host relying on the CLI-mounted install-local did not.
- The dogfood pins boot in memory, not over a file DB: the loss is decided by plugin order and the ledger directory (kept across the two boots), not by the database. The file-DB restart was measured by hand on the real CLI (above).
